KOHATH:
→ Son of Levi Genesis 46:11; Exodus 6:16
→ Grandfather of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam Numbers 26:58,Numbers 26:59
→ Father of the Kohathites, one of the divisions (shifts) of the Levites Exodus 6:18; Numbers 3:19,Numbers 3:27
→ See LEVITES
KOLAIAH:
1. A Benjamite and ancestor of Sallu Nehemiah 11:7
2. Father of the false prophet Ahab Jeremiah 29:21
KORAH:
→ (Also spelled CORE and KORE in A. V.) -1. A son of Esau Genesis 36:5,Genesis 36:14,Genesis 36:18
2. A Korhite Levite Exodus 6:18,Exodus 6:21,Exodus 6:24 Jealous of Moses, leads two-hundred and fifty princes in an insurrection, and is swallowed up in the earth Numbers 16; Numbers 26:9,Numbers 26:10; Deuteronomy 11:6; Psalms 106:17; Jude 1:1:11
3. Son of Hebron 1 Chronicles 2:43
4. Son of Kohath, and head of the family of sacred musicians among the Levites 1 Chronicles 6:22 See titles to Psalms 42; Psalms 45; Psalms 46; Psalms 47; Psalms 48; Psalms 87; Psalms 88
KORE:
1. A Korahite 1 Chronicles 9:19; 1 Chronicles 26:1
2. A Levite, keeper of the east gate 2 Chronicles 31:14
KORHITES:
→ (A division (shift) of the Levites)
→ See LEVITES
KOZ:
→ Also called HAKKOZ
